 Every card in the deck belongs to 1 of the forms, but there isn't an official form card. You can play any card any time, however, there will be a bonus if you chain cards of the same form. For example, a card might say, play another card of the same form, or this card deals damage based on the number of X form cards out. I don't know if it would work well but it would be a different mechanic from what we've seen. Of course there needs to be a pull to draw from each deck but at the same time sometimes some forms could be better for specific things.

posts.name: Blossercubbles
posts.cooked:
This could easily have been touched upon days before, but if we're thinking of a multi-form hero, why not have his base power be a Form Shift? Most, if not all, of his cards grant various bonuses and/or basic things when played in each form. A given card would allow, for example: Fire- Deal 1 Target 2 Melee damage, Water - Deal up to 3 enemy targets 1 damage, Earth - Reduce the next damage dealt to a hero target by 2, Wind - 1 Hero target regains 1 HP and may draw a card. (Obviously he wouldn't be an elemental shifter, but that is much easier to write out instead of pretending to know anything at all about Mainstay).

In this way, Mainstay would have to plan all of his actions one turn ahead, as he wouldn't ordinarily be able to shift before playing a card. I would imagine he would have ways around it (such as a One Shot: Change Form, then play a card), but generally he would need to see what's ahead and plan for that.

I would also imagine that if he had Equipments or Ongoings, they would give certain boosts to one or more forms. Consider a Motercycle Jacket granting Fire form +1 damage, or Steady and Clear as the Ocean, allowing him to draw an extra card at the end of his turns.

posts.name: Braithwhite
posts.cooked:
It occurs to me that you could do some VERY neat things with a multiple form/split through time person.

 

So:

Character card- the "base form" 

Power: Shift/split/phase- searches for a form and puts it into play, but not as an ongoing.  New forms go directly into play over top the character card- maybe keep the HP totals to avoid healing to full each time.  Or each form has low HP and they do heal?  Maybe its even 4 different "Character cards" that you set aside at the beginning?

 

The trick is since each form has its own base power, switching back is difficult.  You'd have to rely on the cards to help you switch. 

It would be really exciting if each one had limited HP, since then La Capitan could steal them as she beat each one- stripping him of his alternate forms/selves

 

So you could have a one-shot that allows you to switch to a new form.

A one-shot that allows you to go back to basic (maybe basic has more HP, or intrinsic damage reduction?)

A one-shot that allows you to put multiple forms into play simultaneously (increased damage, extra power?)

Ways to get them back from the trash

 

Ongoings that allow for on-the-fly switching. 

 

You could have conditional equipment- things that always give a bonus, but give extra oomph to the associated form.

Chains- increase Mainstay's damage by 1

If in biker form, increase damage by an additional 1

 

Its possible he's a Jekyll/Hyde split, but if he is associated with La Capitan, I'm guessing 4 forms.  (LC's "Split through time" side has 4 versions of her).

 

 apologies for the rambling.  this was disjointed, even by my standards.
